log_path.description: Path to the directory containing PBS log files

pbs_default.description: Hostname or FQDN of the PBS server (empty if on same node as GRAM)

mpiexec.description: Path to mpiexec executable or "no" to disable

mpirun.description: Path to mpirun executable or "no" to disable

qsub.description: Path to the qsub command used to submit jobs

qstat.description: Path to the qstat command used to query job status

qdel.description: Path to the qdel command used to cancel jobs

cluster.description: Set to "1" to enable cluster mode (PBS_NODEFILE-based job distribution)

remote_shell.description: Path to remote shell executable for cluster mode, or "no" to disable

cpu_per_node.description: Number of CPUs per node used in cluster mode for process distribution

softenv_dir.description: Path to softenv directory for environment setup; empty to disable
